title: Set up two-factor authentication and review devices
summary: Protect sign-in with an authenticator app and remove other browser sessions.

sections.title: Enable two-factor authentication
sections.body:
1. Open **Profile & security** and find **Two-factor authentication**.
2. Select **Enable two-factor authentication** and confirm your password if asked.
3. Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.
4. Enter its six-digit **Code** and select **Confirm**.
5. Verify the heading says **Two-factor authentication is on**.
6. Store the recovery codes in a secure password manager. They help you regain access if your phone is lost.

sections.title: Manage recovery codes
sections.body: Use **Show Recovery codes** to view saved codes after confirming your password. **Regenerate Recovery codes** replaces the previous set, so save the new set securely. Never include codes, the QR image or setup key in support screenshots.

sections.title: Sign out other devices
sections.body:
1. Find **Signed-in devices** in Profile & security and review the devices listed.
2. Select **Sign out other devices**.
3. Enter your current password in the confirmation and confirm **Sign out other devices**.
4. Your current session remains; the other browser sessions are ended.

sections.title: If an authenticator code fails
sections.body: Check that you are using the correct account in your authenticator and that your device time is accurate. At sign-in, use **Use a recovery code** if you have a saved code. If you have neither, use the support route; resetting a password does not provide an authenticator recovery code.
